[LERR.1.2.7] **Shape.** A `ttl`-lifecycle fact (`CallError`,
typically; similar schemas for other call-shaped
mechanisms) carrying a `code` slot with spec-
committed values and a `message` slot for human-
readable detail. Rules match on `code`; rules that
don't care fall through. `corr` slot threads the
failure to the requesting rule's context.
